cues.en: Instructor: Now I'm going to tell you about a different clustering method called dbscan.
cues.zh: 講師：現在介紹不同的分群方法，DBSCAN。

cues.en: So I'll tell you what the idea of dbscan is.
cues.zh: 先說概念。

cues.en: I'll tell you a bit about the algorithm.
cues.zh: 再談一些演算法。

cues.en: I'll also, of course, tell you what dbscan stands for, and I will discuss the parameters.
cues.zh: 當然也會說明名稱縮寫，討論參數。

cues.en: There's two parameters to this algorithm, but one of them is really important.
cues.zh: 有兩個參數，其中一個很重要。

cues.en: The other one is slightly less important.
cues.zh: 另一個稍微沒那麼重要。

cues.en: And then I will close the video with a discussion of a comparison between k-means clustering and dbscan clustering.
cues.zh: 最後比較 K-means 與 DBSCAN 分群。

cues.en: So first of all, dbscan stands for density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise.
cues.zh: DBSCAN 是 density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise。

cues.en: That is quite a mouthful.
cues.zh: 很繞口。

cues.en: So you can see why they thought it would be a good idea just to call it dbscan.
cues.zh: 所以可以理解，為什麼簡稱 DBSCAN 比較好。

cues.en: But the important thing is, or the important terms in here are density, spatial clustering and noise.
cues.zh: 重要字詞是密度、空間分群與雜訊。

cues.en: So here you see an example.
cues.zh: 這裡有個例子。

cues.en: These are data points in a two dimensional space.
cues.zh: 二維空間中的資料點。

cues.en: Maybe these are like points in a maze, or maybe these are like trees in a landscape or something.
cues.zh: 也許是迷宮中的位置，或地景上的樹。

cues.en: And you can see that there are clusters.
cues.zh: 可以看到群集。

cues.en: So that's pretty obvious that there's some structure here.
cues.zh: 顯然有結構。

cues.en: There's some organization.
cues.zh: 有某種組織。

cues.en: And there's also these like outlier points that don't really belong to any of these, any of these clusters, any of this structure.
cues.zh: 也有離群點，不太屬於任何群集或結構。

cues.en: So this is the result of applying dbscan to these points here.
cues.zh: 這是對資料點套用 DBSCAN 的結果。

cues.en: So you can see that dbscan was able to identify this structure based on local connections, based on local clustering
cues.zh: 根據局部連結、局部分群，辨識出結構，

cues.en: and it also is able to label these points as, well, it would call them noise, maybe a little bit of a insult because I don't know if these points are really noise,
cues.zh: 也能把這些點標為雜訊，可能有點冒犯，因為不知道它們是不是真的雜訊，

cues.en: but clearly these points do not belong to any given cluster.
cues.zh: 但顯然不屬於特定群集。

cues.en: So that part's pretty clear.
cues.zh: 這很清楚。

cues.en: All right, so here you see an example of dbscan.
cues.zh: 這是 DBSCAN 的例子。

cues.en: Now I'm gonna tell you about the algorithm, how this procedure works.
cues.zh: 接著說明演算法、程序如何運作。

cues.en: So we start with our data points, and of course we're always working in two dimensions here just because it makes things really easy to visualize.
cues.zh: 從資料點開始，這裡總用二維，只是方便視覺化。

cues.en: Dbscan works for higher dimensional data as well.
cues.zh: 更高維也適用 DBSCAN。

cues.en: The number of dimensions doesn't really matter, it's just hard to visualize this for any more than three dimensions.
cues.zh: 維度數不重要，只是超過三維很難畫。

cues.en: Okay, so we start by picking a random data point in our dataset.
cues.zh: 從資料集隨機挑一點。

cues.en: So let's start by picking this point, N.
cues.zh: 例如 N。

cues.en: So we look around, we look at the distances from N to all the other data points, and we say, we ask are there any other data points within a particular distance threshold here?
cues.zh: 查看 N 到其他所有資料點的距離，問：特定距離門檻內，有其他資料點嗎？

cues.en: And that's given by the radius of this circle.
cues.zh: 門檻就是這個圓的半徑。

cues.en: So are there any other points here that are close to point N?
cues.zh: 有其他點接近 N 嗎？

cues.en: Now, in this case, the answer is no so we would consider this to be noise.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有，所以視為雜訊。

cues.en: This does not belong to any other cluster.
cues.zh: 不屬任何其他群集。

cues.en: All right, so then we pick another random data point and let's pick B at random.
cues.zh: 再隨機挑一點，例如 B。

cues.en: And then we ask the same question.
cues.zh: 問同樣問題。

cues.en: Are there any other data points in the dataset that are closer to B than this distance threshold, than the radius of this circle?
cues.zh: 其他資料點到 B 的距離，有小於門檻，也就是這個圓的半徑嗎？

cues.en: In this case, the answer is yes.
cues.zh: 這次有。

cues.en: Of course, we have this one data point.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個點。

cues.en: So then we call these two data points a cluster.
cues.zh: 就把兩點稱為一群。

cues.en: We tentatively call these two points a cluster, and then we go from here.
cues.zh: 暫時叫一群，接著往外看。

cues.en: So now we're done with this point here.
cues.zh: 這個點處理完。

cues.en: So now we go to this connected point and say, are there any points that are within the distance threshold to this point?
cues.zh: 到這個連接的點，問門檻內有其他點嗎？

cues.en: And then the answer is, I don't know which circle this correspond.
cues.zh: 答案是，我不知道對應哪個圓。

cues.en: I guess it's this one.
cues.zh: 大概是這個。

cues.en: So the answer is yes.
cues.zh: 答案是有。

cues.en: There are two points within this cluster, within this, the radius of this circle here, so the distance threshold.
cues.zh: 這個圓半徑，也就是距離門檻內，有兩點。

cues.en: So then these guys are brought into the cluster as well.
cues.zh: 所以也把它們納入群集。

cues.en: And then we keep repeating that and we keep expanding our cluster until we have found all of the points that are within the distance threshold
cues.zh: 反覆擴展群集，直到找到所有位於各點距離門檻

cues.en: of all these individual points.
cues.zh: 之內的點。

cues.en: So that incorporates all of these points here and not this point.
cues.zh: 納入這些點，但不是這點。

cues.en: So now this gives us, what is this, eight points inside this cluster.
cues.zh: 這樣群內有八點。

cues.en: So now we have another parameter that we can ask.
cues.zh: 還有另一個參數可以問。

cues.en: And that parameter is the minimum number of points to consider a cluster a cluster.
cues.zh: 要有多少個點，才算一個群集？

cues.en: So let's say our minimum number of points is four.
cues.zh: 假設最少四點。

cues.en: So then, well, this is more than four points so we call this a cluster.
cues.zh: 這裡超過四點，所以稱為群集。

cues.en: Let's say our minimum number of points was 10.
cues.zh: 假設最少十點。

cues.en: Well, in that case, this is not a cluster.
cues.zh: 那就不是群集。

cues.en: You know, they're close to each other, they're close together, but there aren't 10 of them.
cues.zh: 雖然彼此接近，但沒有十點。

cues.en: There's only eight.
cues.zh: 只有八點。

cues.en: So that's not enough so we don't call it a cluster.
cues.zh: 不夠，所以不算群集。

cues.en: And then you can also imagine a minimum cluster value of one, in which case this point would also be considered a cluster, it would be its own cluster.
cues.zh: 也可想像最少一點，那這個點也算群集，自己一群。

cues.en: So, you know, a cluster value of one, a minimum number of points for a cluster of one is not a sensible value.
cues.zh: 但最少一點不是合理值。

cues.en: So that's the basic idea of the dbscan algorithm.
cues.zh: 這是 DBSCAN 基本概念。

cues.en: There's a little bit more to it than that.
cues.zh: 還有更多細節。

cues.en: There's some additional subtleties because we can distinguish between what's called core points and reachable points.
cues.zh: 例如可以區分核心點與可達點。

cues.en: There's other modifications that people have made to dbscan, but that's okay.
cues.zh: 也有人做其他修改，但沒關係。

cues.en: This is a sufficient explanation to get the idea of how it works.
cues.zh: 這樣足以了解運作。

cues.en: So now I've introduced you to the two parameters for dbscan.
cues.zh: 已介紹兩個參數。

cues.en: One is the distance or sometimes called the step size for defining a neighborhood.
cues.zh: 一個是距離，有時叫定義鄰域的步長。

cues.en: That's the radius of these circles illustrated in this plot.
cues.zh: 是圖中圓的半徑。

cues.en: And the other one is the minimum number of clusters.
cues.zh: 另一個是最小群集數。

cues.en: So let me now talk a little bit more about these two parameters.
cues.zh: 再多談兩個參數。

cues.en: So the step size is called epsilon.
cues.zh: 步長稱為 epsilon。

cues.en: That was the radius of the circles in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 是上一張圓的半徑。

cues.en: And it's sometimes called the step size.
cues.zh: 有時稱步長。

cues.en: It's sometimes called the neighborhood thresholding.
cues.zh: 有時稱鄰域門檻。

cues.en: If this value is too small, then you're gonna get clusters broken up.
cues.zh: 太小，群集會被切開。

cues.en: So things that should be one cluster get broken up into many clusters.
cues.zh: 本該一群的東西，分成許多群。

cues.en: And if this value epsilon is too large, then you're going to have a lot of separate clusters combined into one.
cues.zh: epsilon 太大，很多不同群會合併。

cues.en: So let me go back to this slide here.
cues.zh: 回上一張。

cues.en: If we were to set epsilon to be really small, then this thing might be a cluster.
cues.zh: 如果很小，這裡可能一群。

cues.en: This thing might be a cluster.
cues.zh: 這裡可能一群。

cues.en: And you might also get this to be a separate cluster.
cues.zh: 這部分也可能單獨一群。

cues.en: So notice there's a little bit of a gap here between this leg here and the rest of this here.
cues.zh: 注意這條腿與其他部分有小缺口。

cues.en: So if we were to set epsilon to be too small, then this might be its own cluster, separate from this cluster.
cues.zh: epsilon 太小，這裡可能與那裡分成不同群。

cues.en: And maybe this thing too would be its own cluster here, separate from this cluster, separate from this cluster.
cues.zh: 這裡也可能自己一群，與那群、這群分開。

cues.en: So that's what can happen if epsilon is too small.
cues.zh: 這是 epsilon 太小的結果。

cues.en: If epsilon is too large, then you get to be too inclusive.
cues.zh: 太大則過度包容。

cues.en: And maybe all of this, you know, these two, this U and this upside down U, maybe those two would be considered to be the same cluster.
cues.zh: 這個 U 與倒 U，可能被視為同一群。

cues.en: This would be one cluster here if epsilon is too large.
cues.zh: epsilon 太大，這裡變一群。

cues.en: Okay, so you don't want epsilon to be too small or too big.
cues.zh: 所以不能太小或太大。

cues.en: The minimum number of points, you also don't want that to be too small because then you're gonna get lots of really tiny clusters including noise clusters.
cues.zh: 最少點數也不能太小，否則會有很多小群，包括雜訊群。

cues.en: And if this is too large, then true clusters that are just a little bit on the small side might be ignored.
cues.zh: 太大，真正但較小的群，可能被忽略。

cues.en: Now this epsilon parameter is really critical.
cues.zh: epsilon 很關鍵。

cues.en: This is what you have to spend a lot of time thinking about to choose the right value.
cues.zh: 必須花很多心力選對。

cues.en: The minimum number of points is less important.
cues.zh: 最少點數相對沒那麼重要。

cues.en: And what I mean by that is, as you are working with dbscan and trying different values, you will find that there's a pretty large range of this parameter, minimum number of points
cues.zh: 意思是，使用 DBSCAN 試不同值，會發現最少點數這個參數有相當大的範圍，

cues.en: where the results don't really change.
cues.zh: 結果都不太變。

cues.en: So one common rubric that people will recommend is to say that the minimum number of points should be at least two times the dimensionality of the data.
cues.zh: 常見經驗準則，是最少點數至少為資料維度兩倍。

cues.en: So here we have two dimensional data, it's X and Y.
cues.zh: 這裡二維，X 與 Y。

cues.en: So we would say the minimum number of points should be two times the dimensionality, which would be four.
cues.zh: 最少點數為兩倍維度，就是 4。

cues.en: That would be like the minimum number of points.
cues.zh: 這就是最低點數。

cues.en: And this epsilon thing parameter is more important to pick.
cues.zh: epsilon 的選擇更重要。

cues.en: And in the next video, when we get to the code, I will show you a couple of different ways of trying to evaluate the epsilon that gives good results.
cues.zh: 下一支程式影片會示範，幾種評估哪個 epsilon 結果好的方式。

cues.en: Okay, so I wanna show a quick example of this epsilon parameter.
cues.zh: 快速舉 epsilon 的例子。

cues.en: So here we have data that should look familiar.
cues.zh: 資料應該熟悉。

cues.en: This is basically the same data that we simulated for k-means clustering a few videos ago.
cues.zh: 基本上與幾支影片之前 K-means 模擬相同。

cues.en: So I simulated three clusters and I ran it through dbscan with an epsilon value of 0.5 and these were the results.
cues.zh: 模擬三群，以 epsilon 0.5 做 DBSCAN，結果如下。

cues.en: So these points ended up getting labeled as noise, you know, because they are close enough to some of the points in this core cluster, but there aren't enough points that are close enough,
cues.zh: 這些點標成雜訊，因為雖然接近核心群某些點，但夠近的點不夠多，

cues.en: so they got labeled as noise.
cues.zh: 所以被標成雜訊。

cues.en: So we could have changed the minimum number of points parameter to get some of these, certainly these two, probably, we could get those included in this cluster.
cues.zh: 可以改最少點數，讓其中一些，肯定這兩點，大概能被納入群集。

cues.en: Anyway, the point is, you see that dbscan did a pretty good job here with an epsilon of 0.5.
cues.zh: 總之，epsilon 0.5，表現不錯。

cues.en: Now this is an absolute threshold.
cues.zh: 這是絕對門檻。

cues.en: This is not relative to something else.
cues.zh: 不是相對其他東西。

cues.en: So 0.5 corresponds to this distance here on the Y axis.
cues.zh: 0.5 對應 Y 軸這段距離。

cues.en: This would be one, the distance between two tick marks here, and it would be, well, a quarter of a tick mark here on the X axis.
cues.zh: 這裡兩刻度距離是 1，X 軸則是四分之一刻度。

cues.en: So 0.5 epsilon means you know, exactly this distance here.
cues.zh: epsilon 0.5，精確表示這段距離。

cues.en: And so that also means that if you change the scale of the data, so let's say you know, you Z transform the data or you multiply the data by a bajillion,
cues.zh: 因此，如果改資料尺度，例如轉 Z 分數或乘極大數字，

cues.en: then you're gonna need to change epsilon because it's in the scale of the data.
cues.zh: 就要改 epsilon，因為它採資料尺度。

cues.en: All right, so what I did next was take exactly the same points, exactly the same algorithm.
cues.zh: 接著完全相同點、演算法。

cues.en: Everything was exactly the same except this epsilon parameter.
cues.zh: 全部相同，除了 epsilon。

cues.en: Here, I set it to be 0.1.
And you can see that we got literally zero clusters, not a single cluster was identified.
cues.zh: 得到零群，一群都沒辨識。

cues.en: And that's because we required these data points to be super duper close to each other.
cues.zh: 因為要求資料點非常接近。

cues.en: The threshold had to be 0.1.
cues.zh: 距離門檻是 0.1。

cues.en: So there are some data points that are 0.1 distance apart or smaller, but then they were too few to exceed the other threshold,
cues.zh: 有些點距離確實小於等於 0.1，但點數太少，無法超過另一門檻，

cues.en: the minimum number of points, and I forget what I set that to here, but it might have been five or six or eight or something like that.
cues.zh: 最少點數，不記得設多少，可能 5、6 或 8。

cues.en: Okay, so this is a value, an example of setting epsilon too small.
cues.zh: 這是 epsilon 太小的例子。

cues.en: And here you see an example of what happens when you set epsilon to be too big.
cues.zh: 這是太大的結果。

cues.en: So now we got two clusters because the distance threshold was too large.
cues.zh: 只得到兩群，因為距離門檻太大。

cues.en: So all these points ended up being too close to each other because of these neighboring points here.
cues.zh: 這些點因為鄰近點的連接，最後全被視為很接近。

cues.en: Okay, more on this in the next video on looking at this in code.
cues.zh: 下一支用程式再探索。

cues.en: I wanna mention briefly that in dbscan, mostly people use Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 簡單說，DBSCAN 大多使用歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: So it's just the distance between every each two points.
cues.zh: 就是每對點之間的距離。

cues.en: It's also possible to apply dbscan on a correlation matrix.
cues.zh: 也可以對相關矩陣套用。

cues.en: So this is a correlation matrix and I applied dbscan here to identify these blocks in the diagonal of this matrix.
cues.zh: 這是相關矩陣，用 DBSCAN 辨識對角線上的區塊。

cues.en: Now I'm not gonna talk about using dbscan on correlation matrices just because it's not that commonly done.
cues.zh: 不會討論相關矩陣的用法，因為不常見。

cues.en: It happened to be the right thing to do for this particular application.
cues.zh: 只是這個特定應用，剛好適合。

cues.en: If you're curious, you can read more about this, but this is not part of the course, it's just FYI.
cues.zh: 好奇可自己閱讀，不屬課程，只是告知。

cues.en: Mostly people use Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 大多用歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: Okay, I wanna take a moment now to talk about the differences between k-means clustering and dbscan clustering.
cues.zh: 現在比較 K-means 與 DBSCAN。

cues.en: Now in some sense they are kind of similar in that they have the same goal, which is to look at a dataset, look at the distances between different points
cues.zh: 某種程度相似，都要查看資料、不同點的距離，

cues.en: and determine which data points belong together into a cluster.
cues.zh: 判定哪些點該同群。

cues.en: So there are some similarities, some conceptual similarities, but there's also quite a few differences.
cues.zh: 概念有相似，也有很多不同。

cues.en: And here I'm mostly highlighting the differences between them.
cues.zh: 這裡主要凸顯不同。

cues.en: So k-means is based on distances to centroids, whereas dbscan is based on distances to nearest neighbors.
cues.zh: K-means 依到質心的距離，DBSCAN 依到最近鄰的距離。

cues.en: K-means considers global distances and dbscan doesn't care about global distances, it only cares about local distances.
cues.zh: K-means 看全域距離，DBSCAN 不關心全域，只關心局部。

cues.en: With k-means clustering, you specify a priori, the number of clusters and the algorithm will automatically determine the appropriate distances to those clusters.
cues.zh: K-means 事先指定群數，演算法自動判定到群集的適當距離。

cues.en: In contrast with dbscan, you specify the distance threshold, that's this epsilon parameter, and the algorithm determines the number of clusters.
cues.zh: DBSCAN 則指定距離門檻 epsilon，演算法決定群數。

cues.en: You don't need to specify how many clusters there actually are.
cues.zh: 不必指定實際有幾群。

cues.en: So k-means tends to work really well for like spherical or circular clusters and dbscan, as you've seen in examples, works well for any shape of clusters
cues.zh: K-means 通常適合球形、圓形群；DBSCAN 如例子，適合任何形狀，

cues.en: as long as the local distances are preserved.
cues.zh: 只要局部距離保持。

cues.en: K-means is sensitive to scaling effects.
cues.zh: K-means 對縮放敏感。

cues.en: You saw that in the unsupervised learning challenge a couple of videos ago.
cues.zh: 幾支之前的挑戰已看過。

cues.en: And dbscan is extremely sensitive to scaling and in particular, differences in scaling across different clusters.
cues.zh: DBSCAN 對縮放極敏感，尤其不同群集間的尺度差異。

cues.en: So if you have one cluster where all the points are really close to each other and another cluster where the points are further apart, then dbscan may not give you a really good solution.
cues.zh: 一群點很緊密，另一群比較分散，DBSCAN 可能無法給很好解。

cues.en: On the other hand, yeah, basically all clustering methods are sensitive to scaling.
cues.zh: 不過基本上所有分群方法都對縮放敏感。

cues.en: And finally with k-means, each point is assigned to a cluster so you don't get any stray points.
cues.zh: 最後，K-means 每點都分到一群，沒有游離點。

cues.en: And with dbscan, you can have points that are unlabeled as you've seen.
cues.zh: DBSCAN 則可以沒有標籤。

cues.en: So points can be considered noise or at least not part of any cluster.
cues.zh: 視為雜訊，或至少不屬任何群。

cues.en: So I hope you found this interesting.
cues.zh: 希望你覺得有趣。

cues.en: Dbscan is a pretty nice, it's a pretty powerful algorithm.
cues.zh: DBSCAN 很好、很強大。

cues.en: In the next video, you are going to get to see dbscan implemented in code.
cues.zh: 下一支會看到程式實作。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you then.
cues.zh: 到時見。
